prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Back in 2025 I was bouncing around a lot—one week I ended up in Hangzhou for a couple days and basically just wandered and ate my way through the city.
And earlier that same spring I’d already done that classic high-speed hop from Beijing down to Shanghai—felt like half the train was commuting.
Then a few days later I was in Chengdu too, which was honestly the most laid-back part of the whole stretch.
For the Beijing-to-Shanghai leg, the ticket had already been issued as train G3 on 2025-03-15, and it was under Aiden Miller.
I remember it was Second Class, which was totally fine—just the usual shuffle with bags and people swapping seats at first.
In Hangzhou, Gao Yan had already arranged the stay at West Lake State Guesthouse—check-in was 2025-03-24 and it was for 2 nights.
And in Chengdu, Lin Bo had already sorted the Kuanzhai Alley visit for 2025-03-22 in the morning, with 4 tickets for the group.
